features.name: Offline Remote Data editing
features.details: Create, open, edit, and save local Remote Data JSON files without a runtime network dependency.

features.name: Device library and editor
features.details: Browse devices by category and brand; add, edit, and remove local devices and parsed command data.

features.name: Flipper IR file import
features.details: Imports supported parsed IR signals only. Raw, malformed, or unsupported records are rejected.

features.name: Activity sequence builder
features.details: Build ordered local command sequences; select participating devices, channel/volume control devices, and target inputs. Remote Data edits are not yet transferable to the remote.

features.name: Activity icons
features.details: Built-in and custom PNG/GIF icon previews are stored in local Remote Data. Existing remote icons cannot yet be decoded and icon edits cannot be uploaded.

features.name: Bundled IR catalog
features.details: Includes 82 curated device profiles with 1,956 parsed commands, added on demand through 'Add from IR library...' on the Devices tab. New Remote Data starts blank. It is not a complete database, and codes are not verified for every model.

features.name: Logitech USB device discovery
features.details: Windows discovery lists connected Logitech USB/HID devices for information. Discovery does not enable remote programming.

features.name: Harmony One configuration backup
features.details: Reads and validates a Harmony One flash configuration before saving a bare-container backup. No remote data is written.

features.name: Import a remote backup into the editor
features.details: Reads a backup and imports decoded devices, IR records, activity names, and state steps. The editor supports local participant, role, input, and sequence edits; button-map editing and configuration generation are not yet available.

features.name: Export device and activity objects
features.details: Exports separate JSON objects with recovered IR timings, activity steps and source key maps. Individual devices and activities can be selected, including straight from a fresh USB backup, and files are named after the objects. Decoding is incomplete and transfer to another remote is not yet implemented.

features.name: Browse devices and activities inside a backup
features.details: The Backup tab takes a fresh USB backup or opens a saved .EZHex file and lists every decoded device and activity. Selecting an item shows its IR record summary, state variables, participating devices, decoded steps and button-binding counts, with known decoding limitations. Read-only; individual objects can be exported from the same view.

features.name: Move individual objects between local Remote Data files
features.details: Export and import one Remote Data device or activity at a time. Activity packages include dependent devices and remap local IDs. Packages are not upload-ready; remote-decoded commands may be placeholders.

features.name: Reorder devices/activities and add delay steps
features.details: Order lists show remote pages (3 per page). Activities show Start and Done rows and accept delays of 100-10000 ms. Order is saved in local Remote Data only.

features.name: Read remote, preview and gate writes
features.details: Read from connected remote saves a timestamped backup and loads decoded data. The write preview can prepare an offline candidate for a single same-length activity rename; general Remote Data uploads remain blocked. Separate fixed-size writes have been verified on the spare remote.

features.name: Program a remote from this app
features.details: Fixed-size slideshow replacements and one same-length activity-name edit have been written and read-back verified on the spare Style A remote. General device/activity Remote Data changes cannot be uploaded because configuration generation and relocation are not implemented.

features.name: Add an activity using existing remote devices
features.details: Experimental GUI workflow reads a fresh backup, composes locally using attributed MIT code, checks preservation and offers acknowledgement-gated USB upload. Test TV upload and screen repair were read-back verified; the owner confirmed the corrected device-button panel and original FQS1 activity. Startup title still shows the template name. Requires Node.js; extra startup sends/delays are not copied, and the template working screen is shared.

features.name: Generate remote-specific configurations
features.details: The app cannot generate the remote-specific configuration blobs needed to transfer edited devices and activities.
